### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **6** package(s): `@objectstack/metadata`, `@objectstack/service-automation`, `@objectstack/service-cluster-redis`, `@objectstack/service-cluster`, `@objectstack/service-datasource`, `@objectstack/service-job`, touching **76** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **2** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/services/service-cluster-redis/vitest.config.ts`, `packages/services/service-datasource/vitest.config.ts`), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**16** hand-written doc(s) name something this change touched — list omitted above 15 rows. Re-derive on the tree named below: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 90cea476dedee4bb2586f60b4f469bba67904cf3`.

⛔ **5** release-owned page(s) also affected — read-only, see AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **2** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/services/service-cluster-redis/vitest.config.ts`, `packages/services/service-datasource/vitest.config.ts`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **14** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **65** of **231** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **166** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **166**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **107** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **25** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 90cea476dedee4bb2586f60b4f469bba67904cf3` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `8cafa34b6c583efdb7370284df595fe01f81d9ea` — the merge of head `f2661d7099a0458cb377090860c18a573d4c4dd1` into base `90cea476dedee4bb2586f60b4f469bba67904cf3`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 8cafa34b6c583efdb7370284df595fe01f81d9ea && git checkout 8cafa34b6c583efdb7370284df595fe01f81d9ea
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 90cea476dedee4bb2586f60b4f469bba67904cf3 f2661d7099a0458cb377090860c18a573d4c4dd1 && git checkout -B drift-repro 90cea476dedee4bb2586f60b4f469bba67904cf3 && git merge --no-ff f2661d7099a0458cb377090860c18a573d4c4dd1

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 90cea476dedee4bb2586f60b4f469bba67904cf3
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 90cea476dedee4bb2586f60b4f469bba67904cf3` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## 席位 ACCEPT · head `ad6180c576ee9c276cb390c629712e70cb7c275c`

面：declaration(`Clause-②: yes (widening)`,无 schema、无受治理路径),按 TIER_DEFAULT 由席位审。

- 读了生产代码：`cluster-resync.ts`(`ClusterDriverLiveness`:每次断线只记一次警告；所有来源都恢复后才发一次本地 `cluster.resync`;handler 抛错只记录，不外泄；`describeConnectionError` 过 `redactCredentials`)。`service-cluster-redis` 的 `watchRedisConnection` 挂在命令连接和订阅连接上；主动 close 前先摘监听;`REDIS_COMMAND_TIMEOUT_MS` 是默认值，`options.commandTimeout` 可覆盖。`CronJobAdapter.runScheduled` 的 acquire 失败就跳过这次触发，每次断线一条 warn、恢复一条 info,release 失败被吸收。三条通道的 resync 接缝和 authz 的写纪元推进都经 bridge 走 `onClusterResync`。memory 驱动上不提供 liveness,所以单节点路径不变(R3)。
- 仓库里没有阻塞类 Redis 命令(BLPOP/XREAD BLOCK 等)走这个客户端，2 s 上限不会误伤。消息派发器的锁失败本来就是逐 tick 退避告警，不会崩溃。
- 开放问题，全部取 A:不加 `!` / BREAKING(标题已由席位改掉);Clause-② 是 yes (widening),仍归本车道 TIER_DEFAULT;lane 2 的 resync 立为 #31722(p1,本席在 #31597 之后串行做);service-cache 派生连接的 error 监听立为 #31723(p2)。
- nit,接受为偏差:cron 的 lock 警告里 `err.message` 没过 `redactCredentials`(ioredis 这类报错通常不带 URL)。
- 随车改动 `content/docs/kernel/cluster.mdx`(+37):§6.2 讲断线后的 resync,写明 lane 2 还没有;§8 讲 `driverOptions.logger`、2000 ms `commandTimeout`、`readClusterDriverHealth`。与代码一致。
- 卡片线程本 head 门禁对账：135 派生 / 135 已跑 / 0 NOT-MEASURED。check-runs:59 success / 9 skipped。`check-governed-merges` → NOT governed,1650 行，低于 3000。
- 距 main K=21 ≥ 15 → 先 relay `pr_update_branch`,新头绿后 `pr_ready` + `automerge_enable`。

## 席位 ACCEPT · 冲突轮 · head `f2661d7099a0458cb377090860c18a573d4c4dd1`

- 冲突来源：main 上的 #31711(`driver-health.ts`,导出 `probeClusterDriverHealth` 和 `type ClusterDriverHealth`)和 #31712(`multi-replica.ts`)。本 PR 原来也导出一个同名不同形的 `ClusterDriverHealth`,公共名字撞了。
- 处理：合入 main,没有 rebase 或 force。本 PR 的类型改名为 `ClusterDriverLivenessHealth`,`readClusterDriverHealth` 改为返回它；main 上的 `ClusterDriverHealth` / `probeClusterDriverHealth` 原样不动。`index.ts` 两块导出都保留，各加一行注释：主动探测(PING,即 /ready 报的)和被动读连接状态，回答的是两个不同的问题。`cluster-resync.ts` 的文档和 cluster.mdx §8 也写明两者的关系；changeset 的导出名单已同步。
- 这些新名字都还没发布过，改名不涉及兼容问题。Clause-② 仍是 yes (widening)。
- 卡片线程验证：service-cluster 143/143(含 main 新增的测试),service-cluster-redis 41/41(含真实 Redis),typecheck 和 lint 都过，runtime typecheck 也过。

落地条件：门禁对账和 CI 全绿，然后 relay `pr_ready` 已是 ready → `automerge_enable`。
